items.description: Tenant must carry commercial general liability insurance, including contractual liability, with the stated single and aggregate limits, which may be met partly by umbrella coverage.
Tenant must carry special peril form property insurance covering the full replacement value of its personal property.
items.span_text: Full replacement value of Tenant’s Personal Property.

items.description: Tenant must carry workers' compensation insurance as required by state law plus employer's liability insurance with the stated minimum limits.
items.span_text: In accordance with the laws of the state in which the Property is located, and Employer’s Liability insurance with a limit not less than $1,000,000 Bodily Injury Each Accident; $1,000,000 Bodily Injury By Disease - Each Person; and $1,000,000 Bodily Injury By Disease — Policy Limit.

items.description: Tenant must carry primary auto liability insurance with the stated minimum per-occurrence limit covering owned, hired and non-owned vehicles used by the Tenant Group.
items.span_text: Primary auto liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence covering owned, hired and non-owned vehicles used by Tenant or any other member of the Tenant Group.

items.description: Tenant must carry business interruption insurance sufficient to reimburse lost earnings from insured perils for at least twelve months.
items.span_text: In such amount as will reimburse Tenant for direct or indirect loss of earnings attributable to all perils insured against by the property insurance described above for a period of not less than twelve (12) months.

items.description: Tenant's required insurance must be issued by insurers meeting the stated minimum Best's rating.
items.span_text: All insurance required of Tenant under this Lease shall be issued by insurers with a “General Policyholders Rating” of at least A-, VIII, as set forth in “Best’s Insurance Guide.”

items.description: Landlord must carry commercial general liability insurance, including contractual liability, with the stated single and aggregate limits, which may be met partly by umbrella coverage.
Landlord must carry special peril form property insurance for the full replacement value of the Building and its installed personal property.
items.span_text: Full replacement value of the Building and Landlord’s personal property installed therein.*

items.description: Landlord must carry workers' compensation insurance as required by state law plus employer's liability insurance with the stated minimum limits.
items.span_text: In accordance with the laws of the state in which the Property is located, and Employer’s Liability insurance with a limit not less than $1,000,000 Bodily Injury Each Accident; $1,000,000 Bodily Injury By Disease - Each Person; and $1,000,000 Bodily Injury By Disease — Policy Limit.

items.description: Landlord must carry primary auto liability insurance with the stated minimum per-occurrence limit covering owned, hired and non-owned vehicles used by the Landlord Group.
items.span_text: Primary auto liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence covering owned, hired and non-owned vehicles used by Landlord or any other member of the Landlord Group.

items.description: Landlord's required insurance must be issued by insurers meeting the stated minimum Best's rating.
items.span_text: All insurance required of Landlord under this Lease shall be issued by insurers with a “General Policyholders Rating” of at least A-, VIII, as set forth in “Best’s Insurance Guide.”

items.description: Tenant bears the cost of, and must handle installation of, all Cables it pulls or installs in the Pathways.
items.span_text: Tenant is responsible for the costs and installation of all such Cables.

items.description: Landlord may terminate the Lease after an Event of Default, and Tenant must then immediately surrender possession of the Tenant Space.
items.span_text: Terminate this Lease, in which event Tenant shall immediately surrender possession of the Tenant Space to Landlord.
